title: Cost per successful outcome: the AI number Singapore CIOs should be reporting
hook_text: Stop measuring AI by token usage
script:
SoftwareOne says Singapore CIOs are tracking the wrong AI metrics.
Most leaders focus on technical outputs like total tokens generated by models.
SoftwareOne suggests switching to cost per successful outcome as the primary number.
This metric forces teams to define exactly what a win looks like.
It links high cloud consumption costs directly to real business value.
Without this, AI projects risk burning budget without measurable returns.
Are your AI projects delivering clear business results?
